# MyGraph

> MyGraph is an open-source (MIT) property-graph database written in Rust and queried with Cypher. It runs embedded in a Rust program or as a TCP server (port 6660), with a Python client and a CLI. The graph lives in memory and is persisted with a write-ahead log and snapshots.

Cypher support includes MERGE (ON CREATE / ON MATCH), UNION / UNION ALL, =~ regular expressions, unique and not-null constraints (CREATE CONSTRAINT ... REQUIRE n.p IS UNIQUE | IS NOT NULL) and built-in procedures (CALL db.labels(), db.relationshipTypes(), db.propertyKeys(), db.indexes(), db.constraints(), dbms.procedures()).

Not supported yet: range or composite indexes, composite constraints, CALL subqueries, user-defined procedures, MVCC/concurrent writers, page-based storage, authentication (AUTH is accepted but not checked), TLS. Property indexes are not created automatically.

## Docs

- [Full quick reference](llms-full.txt): status, install, CLIs, JSON result format, sessions, Cypher examples, indexes
- [README](https://github.com/julioacontreras/my-graph#readme): overview, embedded Rust usage, workspace
- [Python client](https://github.com/julioacontreras/my-graph/blob/main/python/README.md): `pip install mygraph-client`, API and errors
- [Wire protocol v1](https://github.com/julioacontreras/my-graph/blob/main/PROTOCOL.md)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/julioacontreras/my-graph/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Install

- Server: `docker run -d --name mygraph -p 6660:6660 -v mygraph-data:/data julioacontreras/mygraph:latest`
- Python client and `mygraph-client` command: `pip install mygraph-client`
- Rust CLI: `cargo install --git https://github.com/julioacontreras/my-graph.git mygraph-cli`
